run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the frequency of value k in an n x n matrix where matrix[i][j] equals i plus j
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness of the frequency calculation for matrix size n and value k
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function logic that returns k minus 1 when n plus 1 is greater than or equal to k
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to add input validation for negative or non-integer values of n and k
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function and its test harness that compares f_filled output against the golden reference implementation
